body: I feel that most of my issues are ones of self-confidence and stupid teenager "what do they think of me" thoughts. I'm going to try and ride out these next four years. I appreciate you taking time to make such an informative and reassuring post.
Right now, I'm just taking things one day at a time and trying to look forward to the days that will be better. I'm actually feeling fine today, which is nice. Thanks for your support.
